what_was_done: Saved the initial SDCA-Lite v0.1 implementation in local commit 700d6f0.
Replaced overlap-only retrieval with a local deterministic hashed-vector similarity fallback combined with ghost-token and word overlap.
Extended SDCA experience memory to load the existing local fraud_patterns corpus as additional ExperienceEpisode records.
Changed the LangGraph SDCA integration so BLOCK hard-routes to respond_blocked instead of continuing the full analysis stream.
Added an SDCA blocked response that states no execution and requires human review or a lower-risk scenario.
Added SDCA_FIREWALL stream details for matched experiences and consequence score.
Added frontend rendering for SDCA_FIREWALL events, including decision, confidence, uncertainty, utility, matched experiences, and ghost tokens.
Expanded SDCA tests for memory loading, local embedding similarity, graph hard-stop routing, blocked response content, endpoint behavior, and frontend event rendering.
Updated reports/sdca_lite_audit.json to reflect the hardened integration and remaining limitations.
